import os, json, shutil
root = "E:\\0zhongqi"
q = os.path.join(root, "_QUARANTINE_20261027")
src = os.path.join(q, "_DUP_zhongqi-arena_out")
dst = os.path.join(root, "zhongqi-arena_out")
msg = ""
if os.path.isdir(src) and not os.path.exists(dst):
    shutil.move(src, dst)
    msg = "RESTORED zhongqi-arena_out"
else:
    msg = "SKIP src_exists=" + str(os.path.isdir(src)) + " dst_exists=" + str(os.path.exists(dst))
final = []
for name in sorted(os.listdir(root)):
    p = os.path.join(root, name)
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        tot = 0; n = 0
        for dp2, dn2, fn2 in os.walk(p):
            for f in fn2:
                try: tot += os.path.getsize(os.path.join(dp2, f)); n += 1
                except Exception: pass
        final.append([name, "DIR", round(tot/1048576, 1), n])
    else:
        final.append([name, "FILE", round(os.path.getsize(p)/1048576, 2)])
print(json.dumps({"msg": msg, "final": final}, ensure_ascii=True))
